notes.title: Dungeon Golf V1 is OUT NOW! Grab your putter and LET’S GO!
notes.content:
Hello dungeon golfers, we are very happy to present Dungeon Golf version 1.0!

There's a huge list of fixes and improvements in this release (the full list is below), as well as two new Undead Lair courses.

We've really enjoyed hearing from you all and improving Dungeon Golf based on your feedback, and it's a game the team are very proud of. So grab your clubs and get golfing!

Tony & The Ants 🐜

⛳ Follow us on Twitter or BlueSky!
⛳ Join our community Discord!
⛳ Subscribe to our newsletter!
⛳ Watch our Youtube!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797336/96b75bd672a7f71590dffb5e8bc88b80c9a7346d.png

Full Patch notes
1. Two new Undead Lair courses & cups! Introducing Spectral Swamp & The Old Curse.

2. Control remapping, so you can set up the keyboard and gamepad exactly how you’d like.

3. You can invite your Steam friends to join your online lobbies!

4. Always be your favourite!

 You can now choose the same golfer as your friends when playing local free play.
 And we’ve added colour variations to make it clearer who’s who! (Or if you want your fave to have a new style)

5. New settings to play with!

 Added three difficulties for CPU players; Amateur, Standard and Pro.
 Added a setting to always toggle fast forward on during CPU player turns.
 New custom round settings to remove DNFs, to increase mana at the start of every turn, and to skip character animations (intro, victory and DNF).

6. Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where the player could not take the second shot on subsequent holes, after quitting or restarting a hole when an exploder was triggered.
 The colour of the ball will now tint when in contact with oil or slime surface types.
 Added gamepad navigation to the user feedback menu, along with on screen keyboard when using Big Picture mode.
 Fixed the turn order being incorrect when using the “Sequential” and “Score” settings.
 Improved performance when using Sandy Bunker’s Pro Focus ability.
 Fixed “Score” turn order not keeping the tee off zone's camera direction.
 Fixed a bug where the hole in Skull Quest, Hole 6 was not aligned with the ground.
 Fixed an issue where the ball would take a long time to move after using the Skullduggery ability on a slope.
 Fixed a bunch of issues with Sir Joffrey’s animations.
 Fixed a bug where the Ratling near the hole on Jade Point, Hole 1 could not be targeted with abilities.
 Fixed the “most monsters defeated in a single turn” entry on the Player Card displaying the wrong value.
 Fixed difficulty icons displaying artefacts on Steam Deck.
 Added VFX during Jimmy Fibula’s celebration animation.
 Fixed candles in Undead Lair not fading.
 Sir Joffrey and The Shadow’s intro animations have been modified to reduce clipping with geometry on some holes.
 Fixed the camera shake effect occasionally not stopping at the end of a turn.
 Fixed aftertouch input not being recognised if the mouse cursor was placed at the edge of the game window.
 Fixed an issue where the loading screen didn't appear straight away when retrying a Golf Quest hole.
 Fixed a bug where exiting a course when the slow motion effect was present would not reset the speed correctly.
 Fixed a bug where the game menu could not be opened using the Esc key after a shot had been taken.
 Fixed a bug where the camera could not be rotated after a shot was taken, while the “Lock Mouse Shot Aim” setting was toggled on.
 Pressing Esc will prioritise cancelling a shot before it opens the pause menu.
 Fixed a bug where the game menu could not be opened during a monster’s turn.
 Fixed a bug where objects would not fade when using an ability.

7. CPU Player Improvements

 CPU players Sandy Bunker, Jimmy Fibula and The Shadow will no longer use abilities near the hole that take them further away.
 CPU players are more likely to take a low powered shot when near the hole.
 CPU players will no longer try to respot the ball when they are close to the hole.
 CPU players have improved logic to deal with saw blades.
 Removed a long delay if a CPU player attempted to use an ability but failed.
 CPU players have improved  aiming around spinner obstacles.
 CPU players are more likely to use portals when it is beneficial.

8. Online Bug Fixes

 Online games no longer end whenever any client is disconnected, improving stability.
 Implemented fixes for some connection issues that would kick all players to the main menu when starting a game. 
 Improved synchronisation across players when pots are broken.
 Fixed the ball not disappearing into the hole for client players.
 Fixed the ball placement area not displaying at all in some situations for other players.
 Fixed mana values not updating for all players when playing online.

9. Sponsorship Balancing

 Doubled the range of Mana-gnet sponsorship radius from 1 to 2.
 Reduced Chest Expander modification from 2 to 1.5.
 Increased the Professional Tee Mat size from 20% to 50% larger.
 Reduced Ability Driver range modifier from 50% to 25%.
 Increased the range of the Explosive Putter from 3 to 5.
 Spring Along strength increased from 2 to 6, reduced hops to just one hop.
 Powerhorn Super Shake power increased from 2 to 3.
 Reduced improved accuracy on Champion Crystals from 6 to 4.
 Swapped unlocking criteria for Mana Elixir and Peculiar Pendant.
 Sandy Bunker gained access to the Shoe Studs sponsorship.
 Sandy Bunker lost access to the Crystal Balls sponsorship.
 The Shadow and Young Felix gained access to the Powerhorn Super Shake sponsorship.
 Sandy Bunker, Sir Joffrey, Jimmy Fibula and The Shadow lost access to the Powerhorn Super Shake sponsorship.
 The Shadow and Young Felix lost access to the Goblin Glue sponsorship.
 Sir Joffrey and Vigo Gravemort gained access to the Goblin Glue sponsorship.
 Sir Joffrey and Vigo Gravemort lost access to the Champion Crystals sponsorship.
 Sandy Bunker and Jimmy Fibula gained access to the Champion Crystals sponsorship.
 The Shadow gained access to the Buff Bites sponsorship.
 Sandy Bunker lost access to Peculiar Pendant.
 Sandy Bunker gained access to Mechanical Retriever.
 Young Felix lost access to Mechanical Retriever.
 Young Felix gained access to Peculiar Pendant.

10. Golf Quest Balancing

 Adjusted gold trophies to be more achievable and all other trophies adjusted from them.
 Increased the gap between bronze, silver and gold rush trophies from 15 seconds to 30 seconds.
 The Cross Bones Memorial, Hole 4: Moved the Golem and portal closer together.
 The Creepy Classic, Hole 1: Added a Zombie near the starting location.
 The Creepy Classic, Hole 9: Moved Slimes closer together.

11. Hole Changes

 Updated navigation meshes on all holes, increasing options for CPU player shots and improves the calculation of distance for each player to the hole.
 Added critters to the Volcanic Forge and Ancient Temple courses.
 Fixed a bug where the player could not see through some walls in Ancient Temple.
 Fixed various props that were not fading correctly.
 Mighty Bastion, Hole 2: Moved the spinner obstacle near the tee off location.
 Mighty Bastion, Hole 3: Overhauled the ramp section of the hole.
 Mighty Bastion, Hole 6: Removed spinners near the end of the hole and added sand. Fixed portal camera rotation.
 Glittering Vaults, Hole 2: Moved chest and nearby gold piles to make it easier to reach.
 Glittering Vaults, Hole 2: Removed red barrel next to the spinner.
 Fairway Inferno, Hole 1: Fixed some z-fighting issues and increased ball velocity when exiting the portal.
 Foul Links, Hole 6: Moved first orb set so it is easier to collect.
 Jade Point, Hole 1: Fixed some z-fighting issues.
 Windswept Summit, Hole 1: Increased par by 1. 
 Windswept Summit, Hole 2: Increased par by 1.
 Windswept Summit, Hole 3: Adjusted the hole layout and increased par by 1.
 Windswept Summit, Hole 5: Offset the timing of wind vents so the player can’t get stuck between them.
 Jaguar’s Revenge, Hole 1: The ball now goes straight to the hole from the portal exit.
 Jaguar’s Revenge, Hole 3: Fixed some z-fighting issues and removed unused exterior walls.
 Improved lighting on Mountain Fortress.
 Added decorative wall toppers in Ancient Temple.
 Added additional colliders to Mountain Fortress crates and braziers so balls cannot land inside them.
 Fixed an issue in Undead Lair levels where the ball could go through a small gap between rails and walls.

12. Audio Improvements

 Undead Lair - moss impact sfx.
 Ancient Temple - waterfall, spinners, stone rollers, collision with trees.
 Fixed a bug where in-game audio could persist to the main menu.
 Volcanic Forge - coal and mech pile impact, hydraulic press and swinging hammer improved, fixed pumpkin impact playing incorrect SFX.
 Mountain Fortress - Shielded Dragon Guards now have idle SFX.
 Added SFX for critters.
 Added SFX for the Necromancer’s club during the DNF animation.
 Various UI SFX added.
 Various fixes for audio not looping seamlessly.
 Added SFX when critters are hit.
 Reduced volume of Ant Workshop splash screen SFX.

notes.title: Our Bots Have Levelled Up!
notes.content:
In the world of Dungeon Golf, the evolution of our bots has taken the game to new heights. Let's dive into the transformation…

Old Bots

The old ones simply aimed for the cup or the nearest corner they could spot. Super basic, right? They had a few extra rules like dealing with sand and slopes, making them sometimes go for powerful shots. But honestly, they were kind of blind to what lay ahead.


New & Improved Bots

Now, the new guys have a completely different strategy. They simulate tons of shots, picking the best one. As long as the simulation is spot-on, the real shot should land where the bot predicts. But how do we get bots to decide which shots to even simulate? Well for this we use a theory called “phase space” (which sounds straight out of a Marvel movie).

https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNDdpb20zMTBrNTdwMTNicjc1c2s5NDB1MGprdG15cTFhOWtub2ZtZyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Q0cogwwn9KCZeimBH8/giphy.gif

What is Phase Space?

Phase Space is a term used to understand or represent a system in terms of the parameters you can control. In this case, the complex problem of “how to make the bot take a good shot” is considered just in terms of the two things you control when taking a shot in Dungeon Golf - shot angle and shot power - and then plotted on a graph. Each pixel is a possible shot, with the horizontal axis is the shot angle, and the vertical being the shot power.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797336/39ac477f4774d6f5c669be0b0ab02734bff35e08.png


Narrowing Phase Space Search

There are a huge number of searches that a bot could perform from any given spot (we could fill in every single pixel on that graph!), but it is possible to make educated guesses and narrow down the search a lot. The search begins with the bots' usual path finding (this is the basis for how the old bots work, drawing a route to the hole to try and get them pointing in the right starting direction) and that’s the centre of the horizontal search space. Then, we use a Gaussian Distribution to randomly select shots around that centre point, favouring the middle, but also searching either side of it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797336/5cefb53d73055ea30487398ab1cdeea243acb068.png

The power is searched using a Triangular Distribution that favours higher power shots over lower power ones. The reason for this is that (generally) changes in angle have a more impactful effect on high power shots than lower ones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797336/e42165d0a1ad6496e59bf5ae5d1514ccea3fe4b4.png


Scoring A Shot

All that’s left to do is score the shots so the bot knows which one it thinks is best! Scores are adjusted positively on:

 Distance to the hole (and being in the hole being a very big plus point!)
 Monster kills.
 Opening chests.
 And they get negative marks for:

 Landing in a monster’s Danger Zone.
 Ending up out of bounds (huge negative points - these actually get marked in black on the scoring graph).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797336/037474fbc941ac2fda1279e1dc33fbdaeb8c5e80.png

Here you can see several red balls and might be thinking “but they’re closer to the hole so should have scored higher?” The reason the balls further back are preferable is that they are outside of the Dragon Guard’s danger zone attack range. The ones closer are receiving a slightly higher score for being closer to the hole but being marked down significant as they would end with the bot receiving a shot penalty.


Challenges

The main challenge with this approach is making the simulation accurate. The bots have to use a separate copy of the level, but with just solid objects. Any inconsistencies between the simulated world and the real world result in the scores of the balls being inaccurate, and potentially the bot selecting the wrong power and angle, and the shot being terrible.

This is why you might still see bots taking bad shots around obstacles like drawbridges or moving walls - these dynamic obstacles aren’t in the Phase Space simulation for performance reasons, so the bot’s brain doesn’t know about them.

And mentioning performance - that’s the other major challenge. It is very expensive to simulate all these balls and it has to be done in a reasonable amount of time, otherwise you’ll be sat getting bored waiting on the bots to decide which shot to take! In the end we have tried to find a middle ground between quality of simulation, number of shots to try, and waiting time, with an eye on keeping a good experience on our minimum spec hardware.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797336/cd634d0c3a4a360ae931b1c37a0addfa66b9e69d.png


Conclusion

So, does all of this background work on the bots pay off? Are they better at playing the game? Well, yes… actually a lot better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797336/fe9081baa2cb862c8214c385ebb6c92ba05eb887.png

We ran the old bot and the new bot through Fortress Fairway (from our Playtest) 5 times each and, on average, the new bot was able to beat the course with 25 fewer shots. These scores may be better than what you would see in a real game since the bot was able to get the kills for the enemies and received no penalties from other players using abilities against it, but still a 25 point swing is pretty good stuff!


Are They Too Good?

Due to this rise of the bots, we actually had to stop them from always taking the perfect shot! Without this we have our Necromancer figuring out ridiculously unfair feeling chip shots like this!

https://media.giphy.com/media/sSPQ2d0ssdWBFmKb1J/giphy.gif


Hope you’ve enjoyed reading this deep dive into the clever technical trickery in our new bots!

See you on the course! ⛳🎮

The Ants 🐜

notes.title: A new wave of fixes are here with Update v0.15!
notes.content:
Hellllooo dungeon golfers!

We’ve been blown away by the response to the Early Access launch of Dungeon Golf and because we’re there with you for every swing, every miss and every bogie, we’ve made a whole bunch of improvements to ensure your dungeon golfing is of the highest quality!

1. Improved CPU Player Opponents

 We've given the CPU players a massive overhaul to make them much better opponents, providing you with a more challenging gameplay experience.


2. Camera Enhancements

 We've improved the camera system, and now there's a new "autoCam" feature that dynamically switches to provide you with the best view during gameplay.


3. Performance Optimizations

 We understand the importance of smooth gameplay, so we've worked on various optimizations to improve frame rates and reduce loading times.


4. More Customization Options

 We've added a bunch of new round options, allowing you to set up custom games just the way you want them.


5. Enhanced Rumble Feedback

 We've made improvements to the rumble feedback when using a control pad, making sure you can feel every shot.


6. Additional Control Options

 You can now choose how to take shots and lock shot aim when using a mouse and keyboard.
 We've prioritized keyboard (and gamepad) camera rotation over mouse rotation for a smoother experience.
 Fixed an issue where touching the mouse wouldn't cancel camera orbiting when using the A or D keys.


7. Interface Improvements

 We've made several improvements to the user interface for a more streamlined experience.
 Holes are now visually open at all times unless they are locked.
 Tutorial and reminder messages have been enhanced.
 Added more display resolution options.
 Consistency in highlighting objects and monsters before and after selecting an ability.
 Fixed a bug where online players were not shown shot tutorial messages.
 You can now see In Progress games on the online game list.
 The correct button prompt is displayed on the start screen when playing on Steam Deck.
 Your current best score is shown during Quest holes.
 Fixed a bug where Sir Joffery could move off the character selection screen.
 Added visual effects for Spectral Blast and Temporal Force.
 Corrected some typos.


8. Balancing Tweaks & Fixes

 Reduced the area of effect size of Chip Shot and Skullduggery so you can't avoid exploders with them.
 Decreased the width of Lob Leg and Sugar Rush.
 Spectral Blast will now also affect Gravemort’s own ball.
 Increased the range and area size of Consult Spirits.
 Fixed a bug where the Sugar Rush ability would not collide with push walls.
 Reduced the range of enemies by 20% so that players can more easily use abilities against them.
 Slightly increased the bounciness of walls and reduced the friction they incur.
 Increased small orb mana amount from 2 to 3. Increased large orb mana amount from 10 to 15.
 Reduced enemy mana amount from 4 to 3 (one orb).
 Slightly increased the bounciness of the Ricochet Rubber sponsorship.
 Fixed a bug where the collision of the oil exploder barrels in Volcanic Forge was not removed after they were hit.


9. Hole & Course Improvements

 We've made various tweaks and fixes to the holes and courses to ensure a smoother gaming experience.
 Fixed a bug where objects would render in the incorrect order in Volcanic Forge.
 Quiet Halls, Hole 6: Fixed a bug where the bridge in this level was not positioned correctly.
 Fairway Inferno, Hole 1: Fixed a bug where some pots were floating off the side of the level.
 Jade Point, Hole 1: Fixed a bug where the incorrect type of Ratling was present.
 Jade Point, Hole 5: Fixed a bug where balls and abilities could collide with an object that was not visible.
 Jade Point, Hole 6: Flattened the area around the hole.


Dungeon Golf has an in-game bug reporting tool which is accessible at any time by pressing F8! Please let is know if you are experiencing any problems so we can continue to roll out updates. You can read more about that in our Steam discussion forum or get in touch with us directly in the Ant Workshop Discord. It’s also the best place to find people to play with if you’re searching for some online golfing buddies.

We hope you enjoy these updates and continue to have a fantastic time playing our game! Your feedback and suggestions have been invaluable in making these improvements.

Oh and, keep it a secret but we have something FRIGHTFULLY exciting to share with you soon! 

See you on the course! ⛳🎮

The Ants 🐜

notes.title: The first big patch, Update v0.13, is now live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We wanted to take a moment to give a huge shoutout to all our Early Access players this week! Your reports and feedback have been incredibly valuable as we work to make Dungeon Golf even better. 

Here's a quick summary of the fixes and balance tweaks we've rolled out in this v0.13 update in response to your feedback:

Update v0.13 - Patch Notes

[olist]
Improved Online Connection Stability: We've made significant improvements to the game's connection stability when loading into an online game, ensuring a smoother experience for all.

Controller and Steam Overlay: Now, the game will automatically pause when controllers are disconnected or when you open the Steam overlay, making it more convenient to switch things up.

Quest Hole Restart: When restarting a Quest hole, we've streamlined the process by skipping the flythrough and character intro so you can get back into the action faster.

Mouse and Keyboard Sensitivity: We've heard your input and reduced the default mouse and keyboard camera sensitivity from 50 to 35, making it easier to find that perfect control setting.

Balancing Sandy Bunker: Sandy Bunker's Pro Focus aftertouch strength has been adjusted from 5x to 3x for a more balanced gameplay experience.

Steam Review Button: We've fixed a bug that prevented the Steam Review button from being opened when using a gamepad, so you can now share your thoughts more easily.

Obstacle Interaction: Certain obstacles and props will no longer incorrectly affect some abilities, ensuring a fair playing field.

Mana Management: We've resolved an issue where mana would often linger between holes, streamlining the game flow.

Level-Specific Fixes:
   - Novices, Hole 6: Z-fighting issue on a pillar near the hole has been fixed.
   - Glittering Vaults, Hole 4: Added sand beneath the Kobolds to reduce rollback when hitting them.
   - Heroic Foundry, Hole 2: Adjusted the Lava Golem's position to prevent immediate hits by the conveyor.
   - Jade Point, Hole 2: Corrected distance calculations to the hole.
   - Jade Point, Hole 5: Addressed issues with balls and abilities colliding with invisible objects.
[/olist]

Thanks again for your support and feedback. Keep that feedback coming, and we'll keep working hard to make your gaming experience the best it can be! 

We've got some great feedback to consider and some interesting stuff too (big thanks to Warwick for this one)

notes.title: Golf Quest Mode is here! V0.9 update
notes.content:
Golf Quest

In this single player quest mode, you're down to the wire, you have a challenge ahead and It's you vs the course. 

Take up a new terrain you've never seen as you try to beat your scores. Complete each hole and and see if you can accomplish winning all 9 golden trophies! (There are some bronze and silver ones in there but we don't talk about those). 

https://i.ibb.co/Jrw5rSp/Screenshot-2023-7-28-16-26-17-453.png

There are several types of Quest Modes that can appear in Golf Quest:



 Rush 💨 Set down you're ball and you're off! Complete the course in the fastest time possible to show the other players what you've got! 

 Monster Mash 🧌 The monsters are in control now. Make your way through the level defeating all the monsters to open the hole and escape. The lower your shot count the shinier the trophy! 

 Treasure Trap 🪙 Swing into action and open all the chests in the level to open the hole! 


Player Card

A shiny new player card is all yours! See how much golf you've been playing and how well 👀 Claim the best player card amongst your friends showing them who the real G.U.D.G.O.A.T* is!

So take aim and fire into a new mode today by downloading the demo on our homepage! 

Full Patch Notes


 Added Golf Quest mode: A new single player mode, it’s you vs the course - can you get all 9 gold trophies?
 Added the Player Card: Find out how well you’ve been playing and check your progress against a variety of challenges!
 Improved reliability of ability targeting so that attacks always hit things that are highlighted.
 The Shadow’s Whirl of Blades and Young Felix’s Quantum Conundrum can also target monsters.
 Online stability and synchronisation fixes, and error messaging improvements.

notes.title: Playtest Update v0.3!
notes.content:
We continue to be absolutely over the moon with how many of you have not only signed up for the playtest but have also given us great feedback to work with! 

Thank you all for your input and for giving it a Wishlist! We've been working hard behind the scenes watching your streams and reading your comments, and have made some more changes to give you a better experience. In this update we have: 


 Fixed scorecards sometimes showing the wrong player rankings.
 Fixed default music volume being very loud.
 Added a setting to stop showing Steam usernames for players in Remote Play Together.
 Improved CPU player logic when approaching obstacles and explosive barrels.
 Fixed a rare situation where CPU players wouldn’t know what to do if they cancelled their ability.
 Improved CPU player power calculations when taking shots in various circumstances.
 Added extra visuals when balls and monsters are hit with knockback.
 When you’re trying to use an ability in a non-valid location, the message about why the spot’s no good will stay on screen.
 Fixed minor visual issues on the results panel.


Want to join the playtest?

Step 1: Add Dungeon Golf to your Wishlist!
*Bonus points if you get friends to add it to theirs too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2144040/Dungeon_Golf/


Step 2: Request Access

https://i.ibb.co/MVWLpMm/Screenshot-2023-04-26-094918.png

Request access from the main Dungeon Golf Steam page and you can play straight away! 


Step 3: Join our Discord

notes.title: Playtest Update!
notes.content:
We're blown away by how many of you have not only signed up for the playtest but have given us great feedback! 

Thank you all for your input into the game and giving it a Wishlist! We've been working hard behind the scenes to hear you and implement small changes to the playtest to give you a better experience. In this update we have: 


 Improved accuracy of CPU player shots.
 Fixed CPU players being unable to place the ball if they were knocked out of bounds.
 Fixed CPU player not taking their turn properly at the beginning of a new hole in some situations.
 Fixed CPU players attempting to select some invalid areas when using an ability.
 Made head-to-head matches the default.
 Improved mouse sensitivity.
 Updated tutorial for taking shots with a mouse.
 Implemented visual feedback for why abilities cannot be used in some situations.
 Improved visibility of sand surfaces.
 Visual updates when placing the ball.
 Various minor bug fixes, visual updates, and typos.
